title: Vice Salt Nic E-Liquid – Banana Ice 30ml
description:
Description
Looking for a refreshing and satisfying banana flavor with a cool twist? Look no further than Banana Ice by Vice – the latest addition to the Vice brand’s premium line of salt nicotine e-liquids.
Crafted with the same commitment to quality and attention to detail as Vice’s high-performance disposable vapes, this e-liquid delivers a smooth and satisfying vaping experience that’s perfect for both beginners and experienced vapers alike.
Experience the creamy and sweet flavor of ripe bananas, perfectly balanced with a cooling icy finish. Made with high-quality ingredients and available in a convenient 30ml bottle, Banana Ice by Vice is the perfect choice for those seeking a flavorful and refreshing vape.
Whether you’re looking to quit smoking and switch to vaping or simply looking to explore new and exciting flavors, Banana Ice by Vice is the perfect choice for you. Try it today and discover the ultimate in vaping pleasure!
Flavour Notes:
Banana
Ice
Vice Salt E-Liquid is NOT intended for use in Sub-Ohm Tank systems. Vice E-Liquid is intended for small pod systems.
50% VG 50% PG
